purpose: Make every Decision Intelligence read source-resolved, authorization-scoped, bitemporal, and fail-closed before a derived status, briefing, or candidate answer is emitted.

request_requirements: one closed-world requested audience granted to the authenticated principal
reference_monitor.derived_label_rule: classification is the strictest cited-source classification; audiences are the exact source-ACL intersection constrained by that classification; caller-supplied labels cannot widen either value.
reference_monitor.temporal_rule: A projection may use an item only when item.recorded_at, source_as_of, and source captured_at are at or before known_at, and the source is not revoked at known_at.
reference_monitor.projection_rule: Filter before projecting values, source IDs, evidence IDs, titles, gaps, counts, sidecar content, or multi-hop content.

security_invariants: A client audience never receives private, restricted, or ungranted source material.
A future-recorded or future-captured source never appears in an as-known-at projection.
A revoked source is excluded at and after revocation.
An unknown source assertion, unknown audience, missing authenticated principal, or label mismatch fails closed.
Conflicting concurrent observations remain CONFLICT until explicitly superseded; latest timestamp alone is not resolution.
Derived Decision Intelligence remains candidate-only and cannot write the graph.

runtime_gate.pass_condition: Every adversarial case passes and the checked graph hash is unchanged.

next_gate: W5.1 semantic expansion may begin only after a valid W5.0 runtime receipt is recorded. W7 production query routing remains blocked until its exact runtime registry, source resolver, and independent client-safety qualification are bound.
